info.name: Business Central Automation API v2.0
info.description:
API for automating company setup and tenant management in Dynamics 365 Business Central. Supports creating companies, installing and managing extensions, assigning permission sets to users, uploading and applying RapidStart packages, managing user groups and security groups, and activating features programmatically.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Dynamics Support
 Email: bcsupport@microsoft.com
